items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: He played with Cab Calloway a while.

ctx.x: feature him. So he'd just come out and play. In them days, a lot of cats used to just go around on those shows and they didn't nothin' but play solos themselves. There was another cat used to go around on the TOBA Time -- he was featured the same way. He played with Cab Calloway a while. He died. The man was from Little Rock, Arkansas. King Swayzee.
He's listed in Chilton's book. Did you know him back in Arkansas?
